verdict.rationale: The quickstart documents the full self-serve path: sign up at console.x.ai, load credits, create an API key on the API Keys page and export it as an environment variable. It then runs a first request in curl, Python and JavaScript, with no sales contact. Published self-serve pricing and spend-based rate-limit tiers starting at $0 support the no-sales-call claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that signup and key creation work without friction (e.g. no verification hurdles or waitlist); this rests on first-party docs only.
